name: Best Reference Questions for LA ADU Design Contractors

mainEntity.name: What specific questions should I ask past clients of an ADU design contractor in Los Angeles County during reference checks?
mainEntity.text: What specific questions should I ask past clients of an ADU design contractor in Los Angeles County during reference checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reference calls are one of the most underused tools in selecting an ADU design contractor in Los Angeles County. Go beyond “Were you happy?” and ask targeted questions. Start with approvals: Did the city or county approve the plans without major redesigns? How many rounds of plan-check corrections were needed, and did the designer handle them without nickel-and-diming? Ask about budget accuracy: Were the design-phase cost expectations reasonably close to actual builder bids and final cost? Did the homeowner feel pressured into more expensive choices late in the process? Explore timeline reliability: Did the contractor meet promised design milestones and submit to the city when they said they would? Did they stay engaged when plan-check took longer than expected? Inquire about communication: How quickly did they respond to questions, both during design and construction? Were changes documented clearly? Finally, ask if there were unexpected fees, added consultant costs, or scope gaps that caused frustration, such as having to hire a separate engineer or permit expediter. These specific questions reveal patterns you will never see in marketing materials and help you distinguish truly professional ADU designers from merely adequate ones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask past clients whether the ADU design contractor’s plans were approved without major redesigns, if budgets and timelines were realistic, how responsive they were to city corrections and change requests, and whether the finished ADU matched the design intent. Clarify any unexpected fees or scope gaps that occurred.
